ialized fact-finding and stakeholder-identification workshop series led by U.S. subject-matter experts on U.S. standards of intellectual property protection and market access principles. This program will convene 100 participants from Indian academic technology hubs, legal professionals, and private-sector stakeholders. The workshops will gather information about how current Indian policies and intellectual property rights (IPR) do not incentivize U.S. businesses and universities to seek greater commercialization in India, validate USG advocacy approaches to this topic, and conduct targeted outreach supporting U.S. government objectives with deliverables generated for government use. The procurement directly advances U.S. economic interests and supports domestic reindustrialization by building foreign public and institutional alignment with U.S. commercial standards. This program directly helps Indian co-investment in the United States, shares expertise, and secures the vital technology supply chains of the twenty-first century while minimizing economic espionage risks facing American businesses. deliverables_scope.text: ===== FILE: files/STATEMENT_OF_WORK.pdf ===== CUI CUI STATEMENT OF WORK (SOW) 1.0 Title of Project SmartNet CCTV and Access Control System Installation at Ramstein Northside Fitness Center & Vogelweh Fitness Center. 2.0 Objective The objective of this contract is to procure, deliver, install, test, and commission fully integrated Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV) and Access Control Systems (ACS) at the Northside Fitness Center (Ramstein Air Base) and the Vogelweh Fitness Center (Vogelweh Cantonment / Ramstein, Germany). The contractor shall provide all hardware, software licenses, cabling, conduit, mounts, installation labor, programming, travel, and system veriﬁcation required to deliver a turn-key

ion (CCTV) and Access Control Systems (ACS) at the Northside Fitness Center (Ramstein Air Base) and the Vogelweh Fitness Center (Vogelweh Cantonment / Ramstein, Germany). The contractor shall provide all hardware, software licenses, cabling, conduit, mounts, installation labor, programming, travel, and system veriﬁcation required to deliver a turn-key security solution. The ﬁnished systems must seamlessly integrate into the base-wide AFSVC enterprise security platform, utilizing standardized hardware/software architectures including the OnGuard Access Control System and the Surveill Professional Video Management System (VMS). 3.0 Scope of Work The contractor shall perform all tasks necessary to install, conﬁgure, and make operational the security architectures at both locations as detailed below: Task 1: Ramstein Northside Fitness Center (Bldg 2117) The contractor shall install a 28-camera, 2-door access control and surveillance system. The system scope includes: • Access Control Infrastructure (2 Doors): o Install one (1) Intelligent Dual Reader Controller (LNL-X2220) featuring dual-path capability, on-board ethernet, and OSDP Secure Channel encryption. o Install one (1) OnGuard 32ES 2-Door Package (OG-32ES-2EP2) including OnGuard Server software, CredentialCenter Clie
